# Made once with the 0.2 performance update's build (format 1), before the synth update (format 2), to keep two
# saved projects for app/tests/convert.txt: proj_02.img (the file as 0.2 saved it, the layout on the user's FM-1)
# and proj_perf.img (the performance update's whole file). Run from fm1-eight: app/build/host/ghettomachine_host
# app/tests/fixtures/make_v1.txt OUTDIR (with the format-1 build only; kept for the record)
wait 600
# ---- T2: SQR BASS, CUTOFF 70, saved as USER 1
turn ALGO 1
wait 30
expect trk 2
tap EDIT
wait 30
turn SELECT 3
wait 30
expect epage 3
spin K1 20
wait 30
expect snd2_8 70
press SAVE
wait 20
turn PRESET 1
wait 30
release SAVE
wait 300
expect usnd1 1
expect preset2 15
# ---- two notes, a CUTOFF lock on step 1 (100)
tap SEQ
wait 30
expect page 0
key 0 down
wait 20
key 0 up
wait 20
key 7 down
wait 20
key 7 up
wait 20
expect nsteps2 2
key 0 down
wait 30
tap EDIT
wait 30
turn SELECT -4
wait 30
turn SELECT 3
wait 30
spin K1 30
wait 30
expect ilock2_1_8 100
key 0 up
wait 30
expect note2_1_0 >0
expect vel2_1 >0
expect gate2_1 >0
expect chance2_1 100
# ---- T3: its sound edited too (PLUCK's RESO 40 -> 60)
turn ALGO 1
wait 30
expect trk 3
tap EDIT
wait 30
expect page 1
turn SELECT -4
wait 30
turn SELECT 3
wait 30
expect epage 3
spin K2 20
wait 30
expect snd3_9 60
# ---- saved as 0.2 saved it: proj_02.img
expect saveold 0
flash_dump app/tests/fixtures/proj_02.img
# ---- SOUNDS PER PATTERN on, T2 ACID on pattern 2, scene 1 follows NEXT after a bar; saved whole: proj_perf.img
tap HOME
wait 30
tap HOME
wait 30
tap HOME
wait 30
expect page 13
spin K2 1
wait 30
expect sounds 1
tap HOME
wait 30
tap HOME
wait 30
expect page 3
turn ALGO -1
wait 30
expect trk 2
key 3 down
wait 30
key 2 down
wait 30
key 2 up
wait 30
key 3 up
wait 30
expect clip2 2
turn PRESET -14
wait 30
expect preset2 1
key 0 down
wait 30
spin K1 1
wait 30
key 0 up
wait 30
expect follow1 1
expect psnd2_2 1
tap SAVE
wait 400
expect dirty 0
flash_dump app/tests/fixtures/proj_perf.img
